name: Koboyo
summary: Free infinite canvas whiteboard for hand-drawn sketches, diagrams, notes and slides, with AI and diagram code.
description: A whiteboard where you draw by hand, type a diagram in a small text language, or ask the built-in AI to draw it. Diagram code covers architecture, flowcharts, BPMN, sequence, ERD, mind maps, wireframes, Gantt, Sankey and charts, and imports Mermaid and eraser.io; boards export to PNG, SVG and PDF and connect to coding assistants through an MCP server.
contains: free scratch canvas, no account needed
diagram code language: architecture, flowcharts, BPMN, sequence, ERD, mind maps, wireframes, charts
AI assistant that draws on the board; MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code
Pro: $8.33 per person/month billed yearly with 50 AI credits and live collaboration
